name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
summary: In Dolanaar, Tallonkai Swiftroot watches the woods as corruption spreads beneath Teldrassil’s boughs. He sends young adventurers to recover enchanted relics and check the foul forces troubling the forest.

sections.title: A Sentinel of Dolanaar
sections.body: Tallonkai Swiftroot watches the woods from Dolanaar, the settlement in Teldrassil’s canopy. Like many night elves beneath the newly grown World Tree, he is alarmed by wildlife acting in unnatural ways and shadows gathering at the edges of their homes.

sections.title: Threats in the Canopy
sections.body: Tallonkai sends adventurers against the foul beings disturbing Teldrassil’s peace. Corrupted dream catchers threaten the sleep of druids, while gnarlpine furbolgs have grown vicious under a dark malaise. Ferocitas the Dream Eater leads corrupted Gnarlpine mystics. Tallonkai seeks to cleanse these threats and defend the Kaldorei’s fragile home.

faq.answer: Tallonkai Swiftroot watches over Dolanaar and works to protect it from nearby threats. He is a night elf who lives in the settlement on Teldrassil’s boughs.

faq.q: Where can I find Tallonkai Swiftroot?
faq.answer: Tallonkai Swiftroot is in Dolanaar, the central night elf village just outside Shadowglen in Teldrassil.
Tallonkai asks travelers to retrieve the Emerald Dreamcatcher from the gnarlpine furbolgs, defeat Ferocitas the Dream Eater, and slay Lord Melenas in his cave at Fel Rock in Twisted Hatred.

faq.q: Why is he concerned about the dreamcatchers?
faq.answer: Dreamcatchers are sacred night elf talismans tied to the Emerald Dream. They ward against nightmares and dark visions, so their theft and corruption endanger the local druids and other residents of Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who is Ferocitas the Dream Eater?
faq.answer: Ferocitas the Dream Eater leads corrupted Gnarlpine mystics north of Starbreeze. He stole the emerald from Tallonkai’s dreamcatcher and wears it on a necklace that glows green at night.

faq.q: What is causing the unrest Tallonkai fights against?
faq.answer: A growing sickness and unnatural corruption have spread through Teldrassil. They drive once peaceful creatures, including the gnarlpine furbolgs, into violent madness.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can help protect Teldrassil while corruption takes root in your new home.
As a druid, you know the spiritual importance of relics that keep minds safely tied to the Emerald Dream.
